notes.title: Find All 8: The road to the Maya - Released!
notes.notes:
[p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3637730/FIND_ALL_8_The_road_to_the_Maya"][/dynamiclink]
The continuation of the "Find All 8: The road to the Maya" series is out! Explore colorful city streets, unique jungle views and ancient temples of a lost civilization. Look for different hidden items and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-grabbing picture, 4 level, 600 themed items, 3 interesting puzzles and pleasant atmospheric music are waiting for you.[/p]

notes.title: Find All 7: Japan - Released!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3491570/FIND_ALL_7_Japan/
The continuation of the Find All 7: Japan series is out! Explore the amazing world of mysterious Japan, finding different items and paint black - white locations with colored paints. Interesting, attention-grabbing picture, 150 themed items and pleasant atmospheric music are waiting for you. During the release will be released DLC with an additional location on the same theme but larger in size, where you will be waiting for 250 items.. Don't forget to add 2 our next games to your wish list. They will be bigger, more interesting and exciting, and will also include different mini games and participate in the summer festival!
